configurePresets.name: bench
configurePresets.description: Release + microbenchmarks. HYLE baselines + std/vendored rivals only (no clones needed).

configurePresets.name: all-sota
configurePresets.description: One-shot: flips every -DHYLE_BENCH_* gate ON so each bench races its real SOTA rival (not just std). Rival libs must be cloned as repo siblings first: run scripts/setup-bench-libs.sh. NOTE: SLEEF is a PREBUILT lib (not a clone) -- pass -DHYLE_SIMD_SLEEF=ON -DHYLE_SLEEF_DIR=<prebuilt> separately for vectorized exp/log/tanh; boost::intrusive needs the boost submodule checked out.
